calls.text: 2 Journeyman Wireman calls for Maddox Electric at Animal Kingdom. The hours are 5am to 1:30 pm, Monday through Friday with overtime opportunities. The scale is $32.64 an hour. Site orientation is on Monday’s for English and Tuesdays for Spanish.

2 Journeyman Wireman call for BVCC on dayshift for Shomari. They are working 5-10’s Monday through Friday with a 5am start time. The scale is $33.08 an hour. You will need scaffold safety, working at heights, and confined space certificates. You will also need to pass Disney’s background check.

4- JW Central Florida Electrical Solutions, work at the Space Center at SpaceX Gigabay. This is a short to indefinite call working 5-10's dayshift $40.30 Hr. You will be installing 3/4 conduit for the fire alarm system. You will report once badging is approved.
